_comment: Hand-checked additions to the CHARM fitment. model_aliases: a yard car of make/model in these years is also checked as alias_model (same year), at most at the 'possible' level. extra_fits: a part number (or 9-char Subaru family) also fits these vehicles. Add only fits you have checked; give the source in note.

model_aliases.note: Saab 9-2X is a rebadged GD Impreza wagon built by Subaru; mechanical parts match the Impreza of the same engine, body and lights differ
1995-99 Outbacks are Legacy wagons and some yards list them as Legacy
